title: MySQL

read.description: Import data from a MySQL Server

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the server

user.description: The user to connect to the database with

command.description:
Table name or SQL command to select data.
Note - using variables here can make your recipe vulnerable
to sql injection. Use params if using variables from
untrusted sources.

port.description: The Port to connect to. Defaults to 3306.

params.description:
List of parameters to pass to execute method.
This may use %s or %(name)s syntax

write.description: Write data to a MySQL Server

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the server

user.description: The user to connect to the database with

table.description: The name of the table to insert the data into

port.description: The Port to connect to. Defaults to 3306.

description: Import data from a MySQL Server
guidance:
The mysql connector supports read and writing to/from a MySQL Server.

### Read
### Recipe
```yaml
read:
  - mysql:
      host: sql.domain
      user: user
      password: password
      command: |
        SELECT *
        FROM table

      # Optional
      port: 3306
      database: database
      columns:
        - column1
        - column2
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors import mysql
df = mysql.read(
      host = 'sql.domain',
      user = 'user',
      password = 'password',
      command = 'SELECT * FROM table'
)
```

### Write
### Recipe
```yaml
write:
  - mysql:
      host: sql.domain
      database: database
      table: table
      user: user
      password: password

      # Optional
      port: 3306
      columns:
        - column1
        - column2
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors import mysql
mysql.write(
    df,
    host = 'sql.domain',
    database = 'database',
    table = 'table',
    user = 'user',
    password = 'password'
)
```
